title: Multi-region handoff with capacity quorum and warm-standby readiness checks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement an orchestrated multi-region failover handshake that uses a quorum-style readiness check and capacity scoring for warm standbys. The goal is to avoid blackholing traffic, reduce failed activations under capacity pressure, and ensure model-variant compatibility during automatic fallbacks. This ticket covers the protocol, runtime gating changes, readiness probe implementations, and associated runbook updates.
acceptance_criteria: Quorum readiness protocol implemented in routing controller and unit-tested
Capacity score computed for each warm-standby (GPU memory, queue depth, cache-hit-rate) and exposed on per-region metrics
Traffic handoff executes a progressive slew with rollback on failed health assertions
Model-variant compatibility check runs before routing change; incompatible variants are excluded and fallback variants are selected automatically
End-to-end chaos test (region shutdown) demonstrates <5% error spike and rollback completes within defined SLO window
Runbook updated and on-call run-through completed with SREs
implementation_notes: Add 'ready_quorum' resource in routing controller: requires N of M warm-standby validators to agree before activation
Define capacity_score = 0.5*free_gpu_ratio + 0.3*(1 - queue_ratio) + 0.2*kv_cache_hit_rate; weights adjustable via feature flag
Extend health probes to include model-variant sanity checks: load sample prompt, verify tokens/sec and top-k distribution shape
Introduce traffic_slew controller: gradual shift in 10% increments with hold windows and fast rollback triggers
Update routing policy store to track active_variant and fallback_variants with compatibility matrix
Expose new metrics: standby_capacity_score, quorum_votes, variant_compatibility_ok, handoff_progress
testing_plan: Unit tests for capacity scoring logic and compatibility matrix
Integration test: simulate varying GPU utilization and confirm standby scoring orders activation correctly
E2E chaos test in staging: bring primary region down, measure activation latency and error rates
Load test: validate traffic_slew under sustained QPS with KV cache cold-start scenario
Canary validation: route 1% of traffic to newly activated region and verify latency/error SLOs for 15 minutes
rollout_plan: Feature-flag deploy: controller and metric exports behind ff:region_quorum_handoff
Enable in staging with synthetic traffic and runbook checklist sign-off
Canary in production: pick secondary region pair; 1% traffic for 30m, then 10%, then full if green
Enable automatic rollback thresholds: error-rate >2x baseline OR latency P95 degradation >200ms
Full rollout after 72h of green signals across 3 region pairs
